subject.title: Cron Jobs Calendar View for Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept a built-in Control UI cron calendar/timeline view now, and if so should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41892 be narrowed, repaired, or replaced before landing?
rationale: The request is a new user-facing Control UI mode rather than broken documented behavior, and the open linked PR implements only part of the requested scope while carrying waiting-on-author and compatibility-risk signals.

options.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
options.body: Use the linked PR or a replacement branch for a scheduler-accurate read-only 24-hour timeline first, while tracking broader day/week/editing behavior separately.

options.title: Design Full Calendar Scope
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define the daily, weekly, heatmap, popup, validator, and drag-and-drop rescheduling behavior as one product plan.

options.title: Decline Core Calendar View
options.body: Keep the current list/run-history UI as the core surface and close this issue plus the linked PR if maintainers decide a calendar view is not wanted in core.

recommendation.title: Repair Narrow Timeline First
recommendation.body: Use the linked PR or a replacement branch for a scheduler-accurate read-only 24-hour timeline first, while tracking broader day/week/editing behavior separately.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent current-main ownership signal for the cron Control UI files and prior review context for this product surface.
